app_fee.value: The application fee is $90 and is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: Generally, an application fee of $90 is required and non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers exist but the categories are narrow and vary by program (UChicago alumni, certain service programs, documented financial hardship where the program accepts it). Request it after submitting the application and do not pay the fee first.
fee_waiver.quote: Most graduate programs at the University of Chicago offer some application fee waivers, but the criteria vary by program.

also.quote: If you intend to submit a fee waiver request, do not pay the application fee until you receive a decision about your request.

gre_general.value: Set by each division and program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: Physical Sciences Division PhD programs: TOEFL iBT 90 total (4.5 overall on the new scale used from 21 January 2026). Biological Sciences programs use section minimums instead (see those programs).
toefl_min.quote: All Other PSD Programs 4.5 overall 90 total 7.0 overall

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall for Physical Sciences and Biological Sciences PhD programs.
ielts_min.quote: All Other PSD Programs 4.5 overall 90 total 7.0 overall

english_waiver.value: India is not on the list of countries whose English-medium degrees qualify, so an Indian degree does not waive the TOEFL/IELTS. The only other route is attesting that English has been your primary language of communication and schooling since childhood.
english_waiver.quote: Education in English-medium institutions in any countries or territories not listed here does not qualify for the exemption.

also.quote: Primary Language Waiver: If English has been a primary language of communication and schooling for you since childhood, you may attest to this on the application.

notes: University values follow the Physical Sciences Division (PSD), which hosts most STEM PhDs here. The Biological Sciences Division and the Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering run their own applications; their differences are in the program records.
